Class Solver

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystemSolver.Solver
All Implemented Interfaces:
SolverInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
ParallelSolver, SimpleSolver
public class Solver extends Object implements SolverInterface
Class which defines several methods every Solver object must support.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010

    • initialise

      public void initialise(BigRational[][] A, List<Tuple<Integer,Integer>> UList, Set<Integer> uncomputables) throws OperationNotSupportedException
      Initialises the solver object, taking into account a list of positions of A that may need to be updated when requested. This is needed by the MoM algorithm.
      Specified by:
      initialise in interface SolverInterface
      Parameters:
      A - The matrix A of the linear system Ax = b
      UList - The list containing these positions as Tuple objects
      uncomputables - the uncomputables
      Throws:
      OperationNotSupportedException - Thrown when the matrix A is not square

    • initialise

      public void initialise(BigRational[][] A, List<Tuple<Integer,Integer>> UList, Set<Integer> uncomputables, int maxA, BigInteger maxb, BigRational maxG) throws OperationNotSupportedException, InternalErrorException
      Initialises the solver object, taking into account a list of positions of A that may need to be updated when requested. This is needed by the MoM algorithm. Furthermore, some bounds of the maximum elements contained in the linear systems (max A, max B, max Solution = max G) are given.
      Parameters:
      A - The matrix A of the linear system Ax = b
      UList - The list containing these positions as Tuple objects
      uncomputables - The set of indices of possible zero-columns of A
      maxA - The maximum possible element in matrix A
      maxb - The maximum possible element of vector b
      maxG - The maximum possible legal solution value
      Throws:
      OperationNotSupportedException - Thrown when the matrix A is not square
      InternalErrorException - Thrown when any unrecoverable internal error is encountered during initialisation

    • goToULevel

      public void goToULevel(int level)
      Sets matrices A and cleanA equal to the original A used during initialisation plus "level" increments in the positions needed. See how the MoM algorithm updates A during the iterations.
      Specified by:
      goToULevel in interface SolverInterface
      Parameters:
      level - The number of applications with regard to the original A

    • solve

      public BigRational[] solve(BigRational[] b) throws OperationNotSupportedException, InconsistentLinearSystemException, InternalErrorException
      Solves the linear system.
      Specified by:
      solve in interface SolverInterface
      Parameters:
      b - The vector b of the linear system Ax = b
      Returns:
      A vector containing the solutions of the linear system
      Throws:
      OperationNotSupportedException - Thrown always, as this Solver does not support actual solution of the system
      InconsistentLinearSystemException - Thrown when the algorithm should return an undeterminable, from the initial linear system, value.
      InternalErrorException - Thrown when an unrecoverable internal error has been detected by the solver.
